newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative election win odds lengthen to 3-1.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative election win odds lengthen to 3-1.

text.p: The odds against the Conservatives winning the next British general election have lengthened to three to one following the Labour victory in the Barnsley East by-election, bookmakers William Hill said.
It said this was the longest odds it had offered since the 1992 general election. It compares with odds of 11/4 which William Hill quoted on Thursday and 5/2 on Wednesday.
Labour are now at five to one on, with the minority Liberal Democrats a long shot at 300/1.
The Conservatives took a humiliating third place at Barnsley East, which was easily retained by Labour candidate Jeff Ennis. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
